book.name: Jone
book.title: WAI PII EPE JONEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Lenge Monda Mendenya Lenge Auu Pisakamaiyamo Doko
Jisasa baa kaitini pao pituu kandeamopa, endangimi lenge monda jetae mandea akali mende petea.

Dokopa Jisasanya disaipolo dupame baa tipa pyoo, “Mana Lenge, apimi koo pia mambele akali dake lenge monda mandea? Baa tangeme koo pia mende mambelepe, pande baanya endangi takangepame koo piambi mende mambelepe?” leami.
Dopa leaminopa Jisasame yanu pyao,

content.text: “Akali dakenyapi, baanya endangi takangepa dolaponyapi koo piami mende mambele daa. Goteme baanya kalai andake dupa akali dake-kisa panao pitamopa endakali dupame kandataminopa lao pia.
Yuu kuilyamopa endakali mendeme kalai napingi. Tii pilyamo dakepa, namba puu lea Akali dokonya kalai dupa nambame yakinala naeyao pyakamaipenge.
Namba isa yuu dakenya kalyo dakepa, namba isa yuu dakenya tii pipae doko kalyona”

content: lea.
Dopa latala baame sopokali talyinya yuunya setapala, yuu-pipa mandau minia. Mandau minatala akali lenge monda dokonya lenge dolaponya nyoo katasakamaiya.
Dopa petala Jisasame akali doko lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Endaki pete tombapae Siloamenya emba wasa pyala puu”

content: lea. (Siloame dokonya tenge doko, Pena latae.) Dopa lateamopa, baa pupala dokonya wasa pia. Dokopa baanya lenge dolapo auu pyoo teamopa, baa andaka pea.
Peamopa baanya patali makepi, wamba baa lenge mondana lao kandengemapi, dupame lao pituu, “Akali dake muni akipi tee lao petenge doko laa-kanjemape?” leami.

Dopa leaminopa endakali mendapuame lao pituu, “Baa akali dokoakana” leami. Yangimi lao pituu, “Akali dake baa-yale etete mende-lamona” leami. Dopa leaminopa akali dokome lao pituu, “Namba akali lelyamino dokoakana” lea.
Dokopa endakali dokaitame baa lamaiyoo, “Embanya lenge dolapo aipa petala auu pipyape?” lao tipa peta piami.
Dokopa akali dokome yanu pyao, “Akali Jisasa lenge mendeme yuu mendatupa mandau minatala, nambanya lengenya katasetakala namba langyoo,
lamo. Dokopa namba pao wasa pyapapupa, namba lenge auu pyoo talona” lea.
Dopa leamopa dokaitame baa lamaiyoo, “Akali doko anja kalyape?” leami. Dopa leaminopa baame lao pituu, “Namba masala naelyona” lea.
Lenge Monda Dokonya Lenge Dolapo Aipa Petala Auu Pyaape Lao Tipa Piamino Doko
Jisasame yuu mendatupa mandau minatala, akali lenge monda doko auu pisakamaiya doko, Sambata gii mendenya auu pisakamaiya. Akali doko Parasi dupa kateami dokonya laminao peami.

Pateaminopa Parasi dupame baa tipa pyoo, “Embanya lenge dolapo aipa petala auu pyaape?” leami. Dokopa baame dokaita lamaiyoo, “Akali mendeme nambanya lengenya mandau katasakalamo. Dokopa nambanya lenge dolapo wasa pyapapupa lenge auu pyoo talona” lea.

Dopa leamopa Parasi yangimi lao pituu, “Akali dokome Sambata loo doko wata-minala naeyalumuna, baa Goteme epena latae daa-lumuna” leami. Dokopa yangimi lao pituu, “Akali koo pingi mendeme aipa petala mirakolo dopale dupa pipyalipi?” leami. Dopa latala dokaita wakale pyaloo piami.

Dopa petala dokaitame lenge monda doko deaka lamaiyoo, “Akali dokome embanya lenge dolapo auu pisakalame-lamo dokonya, embame baa lao aipa lelyepe?” leami. Dokopa baame lao pituu, “Akali doko baa propeta mende-lamona” lea.

Lenge monda dokome auu pyoo kandeamo doko kandatala, wamba baa lenge mondana lao Juu dupame masala naeyami. Masala naeyapala, akali lenge auu pyoo tea dokonya endangi takangepa dolapo lanyoo epena leami.

Endangi takangepa dolapo ipateambinopa dokaitame tipa pyoo, “Akali dake nyakambanya ikiningi, wamba lenge monda jetae mandeambana lengemba dokope? Dokoaka-tamo doko, baa indupa aipa petala lenge auu pyoo telyape?” leami.
Dokopa endangi takangepa dolapome dokaitanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Baa nalimbanya ikiningi, lenge monda jetae mandeamba dokoakana lao nalimbame masilyambano.
Indupa baa aipa petala lenge auu pyoo telyape, apimi lenge dolapo auu pisakamaiyape lao nalimba nakanjembano. Baa akali angina, tangeme laapomona, nyakamame baa tipa pyepa” leambi.

(Endakali mendeme Jisasa baa Kraisa dokona lao, lao panatamo doko, baa lotuu anda dokonya watao pyatamana lao, Juu dupame wambao pii yaki peteami. Dopa peteami dokonya baanya endangi takangepa dolapome Juu dupa paka kaeyapala, “Baa akali angina, nyakamame baa tipa pyepa” leambi.)
Dokopa dokaitame paa lapo pyoo lenge monda doko epena latala lamaiyoo, “Akali doko koo pingina lao naimame masilyamanona, embame Gote kenge andake maiyoo kiningi pii doko laa” leami.

Dopa leaminopa baame yanu pyao, “Baa koo pingipi, napingipi lao nambame masala naelyo. Mendai iki mende masilyo doko, wamba namba lenge monda kateo doko, indupa lenge auu pyoo tao kandelyo dokona” lea.
Dokopa dokaitame deaka baa lamaiyoo, “Baame embanya aipa pyakala? Baame aipa petala embanya lenge dolapo auu pisakalape?” leami.

Dopa leaminopa baame dokaitanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Wamba nambame nyakama langitalo doko nasepala, aipuma nyakamame deaka semana lao masilyami? Nyakama apata baanya disaipolo katamana lao masilyamipi?” lea.
Dokopa dokaitame baa lao nepao, “Naima Mosesanya disaipolona, emba baanya disaipolo-lumu.
Goteme Mosesa pii lamaiya-pyaana lao naimame masilyamano. Dopaka doko, akali doko anja katao epeape lao naimame masala naelyamanona” leami.

Dopa leaminopa baame dokaitanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Anetupa, nyakamame lelyamino doko nambame sepala walu lelyo. Akali dokome nambanya lenge dolapo auu pisakalamo doko, nyakamame baa anja katao epeape lao masala naeyalumino.

Endakali koo pingi dupanya Goteme pii nasakamaingina lao naimame masilyamano. Dopaka doko, endakali mendeme Gote mambo pyao katao, baame lelyamoli pyoo katenge-tamo doko, Goteme baanya pii doko sakamaingi.
Wamba-wambapi endangimi lenge monda jetae mandea endakali mendenya lenge akali mendeme auu pisakamaiya-pyaana lapae nasingi.
Goteme akali dake epena naleali doko, baame pilyamo dapale mende napipyalina” lea.
Dokopa dokaitame baanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Emba koo sepeta mandipae etete koo dakeme naima mana lelyepe?” leami. Dopa latala baa watao kamaka pyasiami.
Imambunya Lenge Monda Dupanya Leamo Doko
Akali doko watao kamaka pyasalamino lapae doko Jisasame sepala akali doko kutia. Kutao kandatala baa lamaiyoo,
lea.
Dopa leamopa baame yanu pyao, “Akali Andake, embame namba langitinopa tungi pyatoo, Gotenya Ikiningi doko apipi?” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embame baa kandataleno. Akali mendeme emba pii langimupa tole kalyambino doko baana”

content: lea.
Dokopa akali dokome lao pituu, “Kamongo, nambame emba tungi pilyona” lea. Dopa latala baame Jisasa mambo pia.
Dokopa Jisasame lao pituu,

content.text: “Namba isa yuu dakenya epeo doko, endakali lenge monda dupa lenge auu pyoo tapala kandena lao, lenge auu pyoo tenge dupa lenge monda jetala nakandena lao yapalanya epeona”

content: lea.
Dokopa Parasi mendapu tengesa dosa kateami dupame pii dutupa sepala baa lamaiyoo, “Naima apata lenge mondape?” leami.
Dokopa Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakama lenge monda-pyali doko, nyakama-kisa koo mende nasipyali. Dopaka doko, indupa nyakama lenge auu pyoo tao kandengena lelyamino dokonya, nyakamanya koo dupa nyakama-kisa silyamona”

content: lea.
